bio.text: Colin Allred won the May 26, 2026 Democratic primary runoff for Texas's 33rd Congressional District, defeating Rep. Julie Johnson, according to The Texas Tribune.

A former Dallas congressman, he represented a Dallas-area district for six years after flipping the seat in 2018, was the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in 2024, and ended a 2026 Senate bid in December 2025 to run for the 33rd District.

According to his campaign website, he played five seasons as an NFL linebacker after a football scholarship at Baylor University, worked at the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development in the Obama administration, and worked as a civil rights attorney.

sources.title: Colin Allred drops Senate bid, pivots to run for Congress
Colin Allred tops Julie Johnson in redistricting-driven runoff battle of Dallas Democrats
